scope: Independent runtime ARM64 blocks; no Linux/Android/iPhone integration
measurement: Three timed samples after one warmup per backend in separate processes; GCD reverses backend order. Same ARM64 bytes, 16 KiB pages and checked complete data arrays; warmup touches every private data page. Timed execution stays in context 0 and includes one-million-instruction slice entries; initialization, table/view setup, context-switch checks and result verification are excluded. No Linux scheduling, page updates, fallback or device measurement.
statistics_scope: Direct counters are cumulative, including correctness checks and warmup. Optional footprint phases include initialization, warmup and native result verification; their arithmetic sample mean, sampled peak and latest cover different work from wall/thread CPU execution timing.
view_scope: Each of two 4 GiB reserved ranges has six 16 KiB read-only page aliases prepared before execution; writes use flat. Separate setup timing covers view reservation, twelve page mappings and signal-handler installation, excluding flat tables and engine creation. Kernel samples require zero read-view faults and unchanged mapping counts. Cleanup destroys both ranges and restores the signal handlers. No lazy mapping, Linux PTE lifecycle or writable view is measured.
